decision: No admissible zero-sender from-empty-context execution design established under the stated provenance and no-standin restrictions. This is an original-path construction finding, not a mathematical impossibility to synthesize matching DB rows.
core_distinction: The original runtime G0 boundary follows one received Cold response; the five timed admission functions intrinsically require the Generate3/Source2 prefix, not demonstrably the current Cold response in every direct private-method invocation.

dependencies.evidence: Reads current approval/cold StageApproveInput, reconstructs first binding/source receipts/extraction/use/Release, finds exact Generate Run and production markers, complete journal and source/generate accounting.
Exactly 3 production Generate markers, one account; nonhalted exact 5 Generate+Source accepted slots and one source Run.
Exactly 3/2 actual Attempts; Generate RECEIVED and Source VERIFIED; owned body/seal metadata/full bytes, Capture, raw response/usage/identity and Source VERIFIED Operations.
Complete Source proof and original ExtractInput/request pair/current StageAuthority; exact two source captures and both raw body sets, not digest-only standins.
Cold RECEIVED response checked, archived by record_response, renew+lock_live+meta validation, graph_call built from current wire/raw/meta/step/node, then original _cold_model_before/first commit.
Original reserve->record_attempt->request_serialized_captured->receive chain; blocked provider yields no complete received accepted prefix through this path.

candidate_entries.qualification: Correct full G0 path, but fresh original setup normally needs Generate3+Source2+Cold1 Mock sends and original grants/approvals/release/instances. Sender may be blocked only after the response has been durably received; setup sends must be counted and separately authorized. Stop after original G0 scope closure before W5, or on original rejection. No such setup is executed/authorized by this report.

Can call the real five functions if complete fresh prefix facts already exist, but not a public independent constructor. Guard requires exact current Worker/Store/connection/transaction/nonce/source token/epoch and full inputs, while real commit prefix requires actual binding/current Run/lease. Handwritten call raw/meta/aid would be an internal semantic fixture and cannot be relabeled as the original received-response G0. No claim every such direct call intrinsically needs Cold1.
Not acceptable for the proposed real-stage objective: replaces _prepare and all other four functions with stand-ins and bypasses actual source/generation/approval proofs.

candidate_entries.entry: Copy prior closed fixture and refresh timestamps/lease/approval
candidate_entries.qualification: Excluded; would alter original evidence/contract rather than freshly create provenance. Prior Cold lease was already stale at its original failure; no reopening or repair proposed.

minimum_missing_conditions: A genuinely fresh, still-valid prefix generated through original reserve/send/capture/receive/verification + original exact user approvals, or separately reviewed fixture construction with explicit synthetic non-runtime provenance; neither may be silently treated as zero sender original execution.
For actual G0, current Cold response and its original reservation/wire/response archives must exist before timing entry.

Future wrapper must not stand in for the five functions or source/authority constructors, must keep original TTL/run/lease/RPM limits and proof pins, deny any model/transport after the cutoff, and stop before the unchanged W5 group.
No current execution/rewindow/retry authorization is inferred.

independent_product_gap.name: Reuse an existing completed two-sum CSV flow on another already-authorized CSV
concrete_gap: MaterialInput.column is scalar; definition edits composition.nodes[1].column only
csv_dag_instances.source_snapshot:159-162 explicitly requires not dual for material_reuse/logical_reuse and uses scalar default_column

dual schema at csv_dag_instances.py:133 is nested per-step output; target_for_schema currently compares ordinary target record_schema to source release data_schema, so removing rejection alone is insufficient
independent_product_gap.value: Preserve existing three-node one-read/two-sum structure and both independently checked outputs while moving to one different already-authorized CSV; no two-CSV comparison, new tool/model/Grant or old-result cache.
minimum_design: Keep old requests/releases exact; explicit separate dual material request with per-step columns and exact source/target CAS fingerprints.

Authorize source lineage and target existing CSV independently with existing gates; freeze same source step IDs/edges/operators/budgets and compatible source schema; reject same resource/bytes under current policy.

Save an ordinary independent plan; execute through existing no-model DAG Worker; each terminal result must use the selected new material. Then original exact release confirmation and instance creation separately.
Do not reinterpret old Release or silently expand its resource scope; old results/history immutable.
necessary_tests: Both node outputs independently fold target CSV values chosen to differ from old material; preserve node IDs/edges/budgets and old source typed/history bytes.
Wrong source release/target graph/resource/hash/column map, cross-project/runtime authorization, revoked derived read or aggregate permission reject without private content leakage.
Same-key replay/different-input conflict and unknown accept recovery; original cancellation/rollback path; cold Store/page recover original intent with editing ABA guard.
Legacy single-sum/report material flow still uses unchanged contract; dual exact release/instance inspection validates nested outputs and no accidental scalar fallback.
independent_product_gap.scope_caveat: This is concrete missing coverage of the existing material-reuse product closure, not proof that every current frozen two-sum Release already promises a new material or permission. Original plan requires new-input reuse but does not require two independent CSV sources.
